identity.title: ALMA High-frequency Long Baseline Campaign in 2017: Band-to-band Phase Referencing in Submillimeter Waves

paper_type_evidence.quote: This paper presents results from our feasibility study made during the High Frequency Long Baseline Campaign 2017 (HF-LBC-2017).

question.value: Can band-to-band (B2B) phase referencing, with a phase calibrator tracked at a lower frequency, give high-quality ALMA images at submm frequencies (Bands 7-10) on baselines up to 16 km, and how does its image quality and calibrator availability compare with in-band phase referencing?

evidence.loc: abstract
evidence.quote: We investigated image qualities using ALMA receiver Bands 7, 8, 9, and 10 (285–875 GHz) by adopting band-to-band (B2B) phase referencing in which a phase calibrator is tracked at a lower frequency.

limitations_admitted.value: Complex-structure imaging lacks short baselines, so extended emission is not recovered

evidence.loc: Summary
evidence.quote: However, it is apparent for the complex structure sources that the visibility data cannot fully recover the extended structure without short ($u$, $v$) coverage.

referee_caveats_inferred: Acknowledgments names the project for HL Tau (Band 7) and VY CMa (Band 9) inconsistently with the body text, so data provenance is ambiguous
HL Tau comparison with LBC-2014-SV mixes unlike on-source times, weightings and self-calibration, so the fidelity claim is qualitative
Coherence values are peak-flux ratios without uncertainties, and the self-calibration solution intervals are only partly stated
The 6 deg separation limit rests on one Band 8-4 experiment set, and B2B separation dependence was not systematically tested
Calibrator counts rely on power-law flux extrapolation and a zenith-pointing assumption
Manual flagging is not described, so the processed data cannot be reproduced from the text alone

missing_for_reproduction: Exact CASA version and per-EB flagging lists
DGC linear-trend removal and time-averaging windows
Self-calibration modes and solution intervals for the QSO and HL Tau images
Per-SPW frequency-transfer mapping for 90 degree phase switching
Scan culling list used to emulate longer switching cycles
Calibrator catalogue selection criteria and power-law fit ranges used for counts
reproducibility.estimated_data_volume_inferred: Inferred: tens of execution blocks across Bands 7-9 with 8 s scans, likely tens of GB in total; not stated in the paper
reproducibility.score_reason: Methods are described at a feasibility level with clear targets and numbers, but flagging, self-calibration settings, and code/data availability are missing, and key details are deferred to companion papers.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Data and recipe are only partly specified (manual flagging, DGC trend handling, and self-calibration details missing), and data public status is not stated.

methods_papers.why: Cross-band calibration used to define the DGC procedure
Frequency phase transfer procedure used to transfer LF phases to HF
WVR phase correction and switching cycle requirements
ALMA ATM program used for dispersive delay calculation

companion_papers.why: Full study of 50 datasets and longer switching cycle tests, in preparation
Further details of the observations and data analysis of the HF-LBC-2017 experiments

related_projects_or_surveys: ALMA Long Baseline Campaigns LBC-2013, LBC-2014 and LBC-2015
